name: Reading
rubric: 10: 150 minutes or more, spread over at least 4 days. Lower in proportion to the minutes missed, and by 1 if it was all on one or two days.

name: Spanish
rubric: 10: a lesson every day. About 1.5 points less for each missed day.

name: Relationship
rubric: 10: at least 3 times of real attention together, phones away. 7 for 2, 4 for 1, 0 for none.

name: Call my parents
rubric: Every two weeks. 10 if at least 1 call this week or last week (last week's actual is in the recent reviews). 0 if neither.
